no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Oaktree Acquisition Corp. III Life Sciences is a Cayman Islands blank-check / special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) sponsored by Oaktree Capital Management, formed to consummate a business combination with a life sciences target. As of the latest 10-K (2026-03-26) it has no operations and no proprietary clinical pipeline.
